title: 1 Samuel Bible Quiz - Chapter 1
description: Ten questions on 1 Samuel 1: Hannah's prayer at Shiloh, the birth of Samuel, and his dedication to Yahweh.

questions.text: What were the names of Elkanah's two wives?
questions.explanation: Elkanah had two wives: one was named Hannah and the other Peninnah.

questions.text: Where did Elkanah go up every year to worship and sacrifice to Yahweh of Armies?
questions.explanation: Year by year Elkanah went up to worship and to sacrifice to Yahweh of Armies in Shiloh.

questions.text: Who were the two sons of Eli, priests to Yahweh at Shiloh?
questions.explanation: The two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, were priests to Yahweh there.

questions.text: What portion did Elkanah give to Hannah when he sacrificed?
questions.explanation: To Hannah he gave a double portion, for he loved Hannah.

questions.text: What did Elkanah ask Hannah when she wept and would not eat?
questions.explanation: Elkanah said, "Hannah, why do you weep? ... Am I not better to you than ten sons?"

answers.text: "Am I not better to you than seven sons?"
"Am I not better to you than ten sons?"
"Shall we go home to Ramah today?"

questions.text: What did Hannah vow about the son she asked for?
questions.explanation: She vowed to give him to Yahweh all the days of his life, and that no razor would come on his head.

answers.text: He would be given to Yahweh, and no razor would touch his head
He would become a king and rule over all of Israel
He would stay in Ramah and tend his father's flocks
He would be taught the law by the sons of Peninnah

questions.text: What did Eli think when he saw Hannah's lips moving without sound?
questions.explanation: Hannah spoke in her heart; only her lips moved and her voice was not heard, so Eli thought she was drunk.

questions.text: Why did Hannah name her son Samuel?
questions.explanation: She named him Samuel, saying, "Because I have asked him of Yahweh."

answers.text: "Because I have asked him of Yahweh."

questions.text: Why did Hannah not go up with Elkanah for the yearly sacrifice?
questions.explanation: Hannah said, "Not until the child is weaned; then I will bring him, that he may appear before Yahweh."

answers.text: She would wait until the child was weaned
She was ill and could not travel
Elkanah did not allow her to come

questions.text: What did Hannah bring with the child to Yahweh's house in Shiloh?
questions.explanation: She took him up with three bulls, one ephah of meal, and a container of wine.

answers.text: Two lambs and a large jar of olive oil
A goat, seven loaves and a basket of figs
Three bulls, an ephah of meal and wine
Ten pieces of silver and a new robe
